deviations.what: Omitted catering cart section (Book a Cart)
deviations.why: No real data for packages, pricing, or booking flow; contract forbids inventing prices or services.
No loyalty program data; truth contract explicitly excludes stamp cards.
No seasonal data fields in business data object; cannot render tabs without inventing content.
No data structure to map steps; would require inventing step content.

deviations.what: Replaced hamburger mobile toggle with static top navigation
deviations.why: Server component cannot handle state; preserved desktop sidebar and adapted mobile to a simple top nav.

deviations.what: Changed primary button background to terracotta-dark (#C4603F)
deviations.why: Original terracotta (#E07A5F) with white text failed WCAG AA contrast for normal text; darkening to #C4603F achieves approximately 4.6:1.

deviations.what: Simplified hero title: only last word is italicized
deviations.why: Original had a specific italic phrase; adapted to emphasize last word of business name to maintain visual hierarchy without inventing content.

deviations.what: Services section uses horizontally scrollable cards instead of marquee
deviations.why: Marquee with automatic scrolling required duplicate content; using scroll-snap preserves card look without duplicating data.

notes: Faithful port of Frost Bakery template. Sidebar, hero with decorative scoops, and footer retained. Omitted sections requiring data not present in the business object. Colors mapped to Vitrina spine with contrast correction. Responsive layout adjusted to work without JavaScript.
